Living with dogs means accepting that you will quite literally never have a snack that belongs only to you. The second Bailey hears a chip bag opening, it’s basically a whistle telling her to sprint over as fast as physically possible. Suddenly, my quick little snack break turns into a full-on shareable feast because apparently everything I eat must be inspected and sampled by her too. Then I sit there wondering how she became so ridiculously spoiled like I’m not the one handing over little bites every single time.
